sn35.154:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.154:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, indriyasampanno hotīti?
sn35.154:2.1: cakkhundriye ce bhikkhu, udayabbayānupassī viharanto cakkhundriye nibbindati …pe… sotindriye …pe… ghānindraye …pe…
sn35.154:2.3: manindriye ce bhikkhu udayavyayānupassī viharanto manindriye nibbindati.
sn35.154:2.4: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.154:2.5: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
